name: kondi-linkedin-mcp
description: MCP server providing LinkedIn API tools for posting, profile, and connections

tools.name: linkedin_create_post
tools.description: Create a new LinkedIn post (UGC Post) on behalf of the authenticated user. Supports text content with configurable visibility.

tools.name: linkedin_get_profile
tools.description: Get the current authenticated user's LinkedIn profile information.

tools.name: linkedin_get_connections
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's LinkedIn connections list with pagination support.
